item.title: Change feed launched - corpus baseline
item.description: RSS change feed launched for the ecfr-markdown-safety-net corpus. Baseline at launch: 15 programs, 35 CFR parts in 6 titles, 2,278 current section files plus 1,029 historical version files (3,349 Markdown files under corpus/), matching the v1.0.0 state of 2026-10-22. From now on, every corpus change merged to main adds one feed item per changed section: citation, change type, date, and links to the file on GitHub and the official text on eCFR.gov.
